findings.source_en: It’s the godling’s flesh I seek. This… “Lavender.”
findings.ar: لحم الإله الصغير هو ما أنشده. هذه… «لافندر».
findings.issue: 'Lavender' is the game's alias for the Harbinger (04_game_context.md), who defaults masculine per style guide. Feminine demonstrative هذه genders the referent female here and in the row below (and in the chunk_047 occurrence at Dialogue_Dlg_Gragu_TheChild_01_DropChild) — a repeated pattern, not a one-off typo.
